summary: Genuine RED/GREEN over the real pipeline, independently reproduced. The harness drives the real composite build, the pinned real Pagefind run after the build, and a real strict-port preview; it parses the build's own page-count line and reads pagefind-entry.json rather than hand-counting, exits 1 on RED, surfaces broken prerequisites and route-observation failures instead of laundering them, and stops the owned preview on every exit path. The page is honest documentation: pinned sentence visible in main, zero registry-command literals, zero registry chrome, all facts rendered from the committed matrix entry and the landed boundary prose it links, links resolve to real built destinations. All three documented assumptions upheld: the exactly-0 streamdown.json count in AC-2 governs over the boundary contract's example phrasing (the page states the fact without the literal); the dev-client verdict rides the site-wide Badge convention derived from matrix membership (DevClientMatrix.astro precedent, no verdict field exists in the schema); the RED/GREEN branch on page-file presence was verified by direct reproduction both ways. Two non-blocking recording nuances: the GREEN run's candidate_sha is the base SHA because the harness ran with the page as an uncommitted working-tree file (the bound page/harness/matrix sha256s match the committed bytes, so identity is provable), and the RED run used an earlier harness revision (closed by the reviewer reproducing RED with the committed harness). Static gates green, five-file allowlisted diff, no stubs.
